app.description: School management system for admissions, attendance, exams, fees and communication.

signIn.title: Sign in to Vidyawan
signIn.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com
signIn.invalid: That email or password isn't right. Check both and try again.
signIn.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.

totp.codeRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from your app

challenge.title: Enter your verification code
challenge.description: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Vidyawan.
challenge.recoveryHint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.

setup.title: Set up two-step verification
setup.intro: Your role handles fees or children's records, so sign-in needs a code from your phone as well as your password.

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.description: Open an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator, and scan this code.
scan.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
scan.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app instead

enter.title: Enter the code
enter.description: Enter the 6-digit code your app shows for Vidyawan.

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.warning: Save these codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone.

take.readOnly: You can view attendance but not change it.
